caption:
Most quotes die quietly in a diary.

Every quote needs a follow-up call. It sits in a diary and gets forgotten.
A small automation can note the follow-up date, send the nudge on WhatsApp and book the visit when the customer replies.

Example data.

Follow for one business automation every day. Send this to whoever does your follow-ups.

scenes.vo: Every quote needs a follow-up call. It sits in a diary and gets *forgotten.* Every day.
Here is the *fix.* No quote ever waits on someone's memory again.
It *notes* the follow-up date, *waits* two days, and *sends* the nudge on WhatsApp.
Then it *books* the visit on reply. Your team only checks the odd ones.
Follow for one sales automation every day.

title: The follow-up that never happens

message.text: Hi Ramesh ji, following up on the quotation Q-512. Shall we fix a visit this week?
